caption: Estate of Billy S. Rowland, Deceased, James A. Park, Executor v. Commissioner

source.document_title: Memorandum Opinion Chief Judge Urda - T.C. Memo. 2025-76. An appropriate order will be issued.

found_facts.snippet: It calculated a DSUE amount of $3,712,562, derived from the following inputs: Basic Exclusion Amount $5,450,000 Estimated Gross Estate (3,000,000) Estimated Total Allowable Deductions 1,500,000 Adjusted Taxable Gifts (237,438) Total DSUE 3,712,562
moved the due date from January 9 to July 8, 2017 ... mailed the Form 706 ... on December 29, 2017, which the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) received on January 2, 2018.
specific bequests totaling $950,000 ... payments to 13 named beneficiaries, totaling $1,401,000

Billy's Return added this amount to the 2018 basic exclusion amount, $11,180,000, resulting in an applicable exclusion of $14,892,562. Billy's Return reported a net estate tax of $4,477,555 and claimed a refund of $22,445 based on a previous payment of $4,500,000.

issue: Whether Fay's estate made a valid portability election (late return under the Rev. Proc. 2017-34 safe harbor; 'complete and properly prepared' return despite estimated values).
holding: No valid election; Billy's estate cannot use any DSUE. Partial summary judgment for the Commissioner; substantial compliance and equitable estoppel rejected.

steps: Incremental tax from losing DSUE at 40% marginal rate: 0.40 x 3,712,562 = 1,485,025 (derived, not stated)
Implied tax base if net tax = tt(B) - tt(14,892,562) with no other credits: B = 26,086,450 (derived; the return may include other credits)
recomputation.reconciles: DSUE and applicable exclusion exact; deficiency not in opinion

judgment: validity/completeness of return; substantial compliance; estoppel
computation: DSUE formula, applicable exclusion, effect of DSUE = 0

caveats: Fay's gross estate and deductions were estimates on her return; the DSUE inputs are reported figures, not court findings.
Order on partial summary judgment; final deficiency not determined in this opinion.
